name: When A Person Sins Against You
overview: Scripture teaches that when a person sins against you, forgiveness is essential because God promises to forgive those who forgive others, emphasizing the grace believers live under rather than the law. Addressing sin should be done privately and lovingly to restore relationships, as Jesus instructs us to confront a brother who has trespassed in a way that seeks reconciliation. Believers are also warned against judgment, recognizing that judging others condemns oneself, since all have sinned. Ultimately, responding to offenses involves offering ourselves as living sacrifices, committed to holy and acceptable service to God.
